en: Black-and-white divided-view postcard showing two scenes from a rural German village. The left image depicts a small church with a steep tiled roof, tower and spire, surrounded by a stone wall and garden, labeled "Kirche". The right image shows a tree-lined village street with fenced gardens and several people walking along the road, labeled "Dorfstraße". At the bottom, in decorative script, it reads "Schönfeld bei Großenhain".
